concepts.name: The Missed Call

Handheld drift along a work van parked outside a suburban house at dusk, tailgate open, tools stowed, quiet street, no people, cinematic

concepts.name: The Empty Search
concepts.visual: a homeowner's phone at night showing a search with nothing credible to pick
body_prompts: Slow push in overhead on a kitchen counter at night, a phone glowing with a blank search field, water beading near the sink, no people, moody
Slow push in on a dripping pipe under a kitchen sink, torchlight, a drop falling and rippling in a pool, no people, macro cinematic
